decision_notes: Autonomous regional legislature within Italy; regional legislative powers under the Constitution and Sicily’s special statute. Wikidata Q2707406 identifies the Assembly rather than the island/region.

Official provenance and proceedings: The official Lavori d’Aula archive exposes dated video segments through normal public controls. The 21 October 2026 segment plays at 30 minutes and the 22 October 05:42 segment plays from its opening with actual chamber business visible; both decode advancing frames. The session 279 index spans several dates and video parts, so a part is not counted as a separate channel. The institution-linked YouTube channel additionally has validated committee VI/Antimafia recordings from 2021; these are historical. Live plenary and current committee coverage remain unvalidated. The decorative homepage video is not proceedings evidence.

Source conditions: The official archive and institution-linked provider designate public viewing. The reviewed privacy/cookie page does not establish an independent audiovisual reuse licence. Link to the archive; do not extract or independently embed the media without separate evidence.
Added as official link-out; regional flag, parent-country search, map and planned event/recording-index links reconciled.
